name: search
title: Search
summary: Finding products: a product index built from catalog, offers, inventory and reviews events; search with misspelling tolerance and corrections, suggestions (queries, categories, brands, stores, products, recent searches), universal and category filters with counts, sorting, sponsored slots from advertising, and guidance for empty or unavailable results.
owns: Product search index (OpenSearch in production; a MongoDB engine for development and tests)
Search and category listings with universal filters (category, price, brand, rating, seller, condition, availability, delivery) and category attribute filters
Facets with counts, applied-filter chips with individual removal and clear all
Sorting: recommended (published ranking policy), price ascending/descending, newest, highest rated; best selling once sales history exists
Suggestions: queries, categories, brands, seller stores (leading to the store page), products
Misspelling tolerance and 'Showing results for … / Search instead for …'
Store match card (sellers are not mixed into product results)
Empty-result guidance: remove one filter (with counts), nearby categories, tips, popular products
Recently searched (per customer or guest session) with removal and clear all
Popular searches: the most searched keywords with results across the store
Search synonyms, reindexing, zero-result query reporting, ranking policy
notOwns: Which ads appear and where: advertising (search asks for sponsored slots and marks them)
Product content and category tree: catalog
Prices, featured offer and delivery estimates: offers (search indexes them)
Homepage sections and curated collections: content (uses search for product cards and listings)
Recently viewed products: customers; back-in-stock alerts: wishlist
Personalized recommendations and visual search: later projects (plan ch. 4)

sellerSlugs.desc: REST seller: seller slugs; 'official' is the Official Store

inStockOnly.desc: Default from the setting excludeOutOfStockByDefault (true): in stock now

q.desc: Free text; without it this is a listing (category, brand, seller, collection)

filters.desc: Same meaning as the REST query parameters of GET /products and GraphQL SearchFilterInput

variantId.desc: The variant the card shows for the active filters

offerId.desc: The offer whose price the card shows (the seller's offer under a seller filter)

priceIsFrom.desc: True when the price is the lowest of several ('From $…')

placement.desc: Advertising placement key: search_top_row, category_inline, category_banner

positions.desc: Inline only: 1-based grid positions where a labelled sponsored card may be inserted

image.desc: The product image in the thumbnail size (url = thumb; detailUrl for a larger view)

variantId.desc: Variant matched by the filters (e.g. color), else the featured variant

rating.desc: Null when there are no reviews (never shown as 0 stars)

price.desc: Featured offer's price, or the lowest eligible offer when priceIsFrom

priceIsFrom.desc: 'from' price belongs to one named eligible offer (offerId, sellerName)

sellerSlug.desc: Storefront slug of the card's seller for /shop/{slug} (sellers' public API); null for the Official Store or when sellers cannot answer

deliveryCue.desc: e.g. 'Free delivery Fri, Oct 16' for the default or given postal code

isNewListing.desc: First listed within newArrivalsWindowDays (the New listing badge)

impressionToken.desc: From advertising; send with impressions and clicks

slot.desc: Sponsored only: a separate labelled row above results (search) or inline grid positions (category). Positions come from advertising.

searchInsteadFor.desc: Original query, to run exactly with exact=true

removeQuery.desc: Query string for the same search without this filter

value.desc: The value the filter takes: category, brand and store slugs (official for the Official Store), condition codes, attribute values

count.desc: Results if this value is added to the current filters

note.desc: e.g. 'Shows company offers at the prices listed' for Official Store

priceMin.desc: Price presets only (facet price): send as priceMin (minor units); null = no lower bound

priceMax.desc: Price presets only: send as priceMax (minor units); null = no upper bound

key.desc: Query parameter name, or the attribute key for category facets

group.desc: category = attribute filters of the current category, e.g. 'Headphone features'

available.desc: best_selling stays unavailable until enough sales history exists

note.desc: 'Stores are listed here, not mixed into product results.'

removableFilters.desc: Each single filter to remove with the result count it gives

popular.desc: Popular in-stock products in the closest category

searchId.desc: Identifies this result set for click logging and returning to results

totalLabel.desc: e.g. '128 results from 9 sellers, including the Official Store'

rankingNote.desc: 'Sponsored items are paid placements and are labeled.' with a link to the ranking policy

recent.desc: Only when a customer or guest session is present and recent searches are on

from.desc: one_way: the term that expands to terms

code.desc: Normalized GTIN (UPC-A, EAN-13, GTIN-14; check digit verified)

variantId.desc: The variant carrying this GTIN, so the product page opens on it

fallbackQuery.desc: When nothing is listed with this code: the code itself, so the app can open search results with the empty guidance

ref.desc: Order or return reference, seller SKU

title.desc: Order ref + customer, seller name, product title, customer name

subtitle.desc: Status label, email (masked unless the caller may see contact details), SKU

screen.desc: Screen id to open, e.g. admin/order, admin/seller, admin/product-review, admin/customer, seller/order, seller/offer, seller/return

more.desc: More matches exist; 'See all' opens the module's list with q

groups.desc: Only groups the caller may see and whose module is enabled; empty groups are left out

tables.name: search_documents
tables.desc: One row per purchasable product: denormalized from catalog, offers, inventory, reviews and promotions events

columns.title: text
columns.on_sale: bool (an active campaign price from promotions or a verified compare-at on the featured offer)
columns.terms: jsonb? (development engine: stemmed words of the title and brand (weight 1), category (0.4), attributes (0.2) and description (0.1), as [{t, w}])
columns.offers: jsonb? (the product's offers as search_offers stores them, kept in step by the repository; the MongoDB engine reads them here instead of joining search_offers on every query, docs/07-search-speed-plan.md)
columns.card_all: jsonb? (MongoDB engine: the card offer among all offers — featured first, then in stock, cheapest, offer id — with its featured flag; recomputed from offers and featured_offer_id on every change)
columns.card_in_stock: jsonb? (the card offer among the in-stock offers, same order; null when none is in stock)
columns.rank_all: jsonb? (MongoDB engine: the recommended-sort score of a listing (no words) with card_all, under the ranking weights of rank_key; a number)
columns.rank_in_stock: jsonb? (the same with card_in_stock (in-stock only listings); a number)
columns.rank_key: text? (the ranking weights rank_all and rank_in_stock were computed with; null when an input changed since, and the engine recomputes them before a listing)
columns.best_seller_rank: int? (rank in best_seller_category_id by sales_30d; null outside the top 100)

tables.name: search_offers
tables.desc: Offer-level rows so seller, condition and price filters show the matching seller's price (e.g. Official Store filter shows company offers)

tables.name: suggestion_terms
tables.desc: Popular queries, category, brand, store and product names for suggestions and spelling correction

tables.name: query_log
tables.desc: Every search (partitioned by month); feeds zero-result reports, suggestions and ranking

tables.name: product_sales_daily
tables.desc: Units and orders per product per market day (decision S-D3), fed idempotently by orders events through the inbox; the nightly job sums the last 30 days into search_documents.sales_30d. Rebuildable from orders

stateMachines.name: Reindex job
stateMachines.notes: One full reindex at a time (REINDEX_ALREADY_RUNNING). Scoped jobs only mark documents dirty. The live index keeps serving during a full rebuild (new rows swap in per product).

endpoints.summary: Search results or category listing (product cards with sponsored slots marked)
endpoints.desc: Without q this is a category, brand, seller or collection listing. Out-of-stock products are excluded unless availability=include_out_of_stock. Seller and condition filters show the matching seller's offer price. Sponsored hits come from advertising.sponsoredForResults on the first page only and always carry a visible label; when advertising is off there are none. Ad personalization: personalizationAllowed is true only for a signed-in customer whose marketing preferences allow personalized recommendations (customers.getMarketingConsent), with their customerId; visitors always get false (visitor sessions carry no privacy choice), so their ads use page context only (query, category).

q.desc: Names, brands, keywords and seller names; a full GTIN/UPC also matches the product carrying it

exact.desc: Search exactly for q without correction ('Search instead for …')

seller.desc: Seller slugs; 'official' for the Official Store

onSale.desc: Only products with a deal price now (active campaign price or verified was-price), e.g. a category's deals teaser with category + onSale

postalCode.desc: For delivery cues and the arrives-by filter

endpoints.desc: Takes the same query parameters as GET /products. The app renders a results screen with this call plus the first page of /products.

onSale.desc: Same as GET /products: only products with a deal price now, so facet counts match the deals list

endpoints.desc: The most searched keywords of the last 30 days that found results (suggestion_terms of kind query, rebuilt hourly by search.refresh-suggestions), most searched first. A keyword needs at least popularSearchesMinCount searches to be listed.

endpoints.desc: The app's 'Scan a barcode' reads the code on the device and sends it here. Matches search_documents.gtins (only purchasable, listed products). No match returns match=false with fallbackQuery so the app can show search results with empty guidance; it is logged as an unavailable search.

endpoints.summary: Published 'How results are ranked'
Seller Center top-bar search across own orders, offers/SKUs and returns
endpoints.desc: Fan-out over enabled modules' public APIs with the seller from the session: orders.listOrdersForSeller (order ref, buyer name, product), offers.searchOwnOffers (title, seller SKU, GTIN) and returns.listForSeller with q (return ref, order ref). Each group only when the member may see it (owners see every group): Orders when the member holds any orders.fulfillment.* permission; Offers and SKUs with any offers.* permission (e.g. offers.offers.manage, offers.prices.manage, offers.bulk.update, offers.offers.export); Returns with any returns.* permission (e.g. returns.requests.respond, returns.refunds.issue). A disabled module's group disappears. Nothing is indexed here; each group comes from its owning module.

endpoints.summary: Back-office top-bar quick search across orders, sellers, products and customers
endpoints.desc: Matches by reference, name, email, SKU or GTIN. Fan-out over enabled modules' public APIs, each group only when the caller holds its permission: Orders through orders.listOrdersAdmin (orders.orders.view); Sellers through sellers.searchSellers (sellers.accounts.view); Customers through customers.searchCustomers (customers.accounts.view; the email is masked without orders.customers.view-contact); Offers and SKUs through offers.listOffersAdmin (offers.offers.view); Products from this module's index (listed products, also by GTIN) for every staff member, no permission needed (it is the public catalog). The lookup itself is not audited; opening a record is.

consumes.does: Refresh the seller's offers and store suggestion

consumes.name: sellers.seller.suspended
consumes.does: Remove the store from suggestions; offers update through offers events

consumes.name: sellers.seller.reinstated
consumes.does: Restore the store suggestion

consumes.name: sellers.seller.closed
consumes.does: Remove the store from suggestions

consumes.name: promotions.campaign.started
consumes.does: Update deal badges, was prices and deal end times on cards

consumes.name: promotions.campaign.ended
consumes.does: Remove deal badges

consumes.name: orders.order.placed
consumes.does: Add the order's units per product to product_sales_daily for the placed day (items read with orders.getOrder; inbox-claimed per event so redelivery never counts twice). Feeds best-selling sort and popularity (phase 2 sort)

consumes.name: orders.order.cancelled
consumes.does: Subtract the cancelled order's units from product_sales_daily for the day it was placed (inbox-claimed), so declined-payment orders do not count as sales

consumes.name: identity.guest_session.claimed
consumes.does: Merge the guest session's recent searches into the account (identity calls nothing in search)

consumes.name: catalog.brand.changed
consumes.does: Reindex the brand name, slug and status on the brand's product documents and brand suggestions; only active brands are suggested or offered as a facet

consumes.name: customers.marketing_preferences.changed
consumes.does: recentSearches false: delete the customer's saved recent searches and stop saving new ones; true: start saving again (nothing is restored)

jobs.name: search.refresh-delivery-flags
jobs.does: Recompute 'Ships today' and arrives-by flags as dispatch cutoffs pass (arrival = dispatch days + transitBusinessDays)

jobs.name: search.prune-logs
jobs.does: Delete recent searches older than the retention period and query/click logs older than 13 months

integrations.purpose: Stemmed word and prefix matching over the read model, ranking, misspelling correction and suggestions without a search cluster

INVALID_FILTER.meaning: Unknown filter key or value for this category. details.filter

SORT_NOT_AVAILABLE.meaning: best_selling is not offered until there is enough sales history

REINDEX_ALREADY_RUNNING.meaning: A full reindex is already running. details.jobId

SYNONYM_CONFLICT.meaning: A term is already in another active equivalent set. details.synonymId

notes: Quick lookups (seller and admin top bars, GET /quick and GET /lookup) are federated, not indexed: search calls each enabled module's list function with q and a small limit, filters groups by the caller's permissions and links each hit to its screen. A disabled module's group simply disappears. Product hits in the admin lookup also match GTINs and come from search_documents (listed products); unlisted drafts are found through offers SKUs.

Barcode scanning: GTINs are copied from catalog variants into search_documents.gtins (normalized, check digit verified) on catalog.product.approved / updated; GET /barcodes/{code} and a q that is a full GTIN resolve through them. Codes that match nothing are recorded as unavailable searches.

onSale: search_documents.on_sale is set from promotions.campaign.started / ended (active campaign price) and from a verified compare-at on the featured offer (offers.offer.price_changed); the category deals teaser is GET /products?category=…&onSale=true.

Recommended sort (published ranking policy v1): text relevance, then in-stock and featured-offer eligibility, delivery speed to the location, rating with enough reviews, and recent conversion. Sponsored placement never changes organic rank; sponsored hits are separate, labelled and come from advertising.
'From' prices always belong to one eligible offer named on the card (plan ch. 4). With a seller filter (e.g. Official Store) the card shows that seller's offer at the price listed.
Seller names in queries produce a store match card and store suggestions leading to the store page; seller records are never mixed into product results.

Universal filters always appear; category filters come from catalog attributes marked filterable for the current category (e.g. screen size, capacity, size). Facet counts are computed against the other active filters so each value shows what selecting it would give.

Empty results: EmptyGuidance lists each applied filter with the result count after removing it, nearby categories, tips and popular products. Product-level unavailability (out of stock, discontinued) is explained by the offers purchase box (store endpoint getPurchaseBox) and catalog; search supplies similar in-stock products.
Returning to previous results: the query string is the state; searchId plus page/cursor restores the same page after viewing a product.

Recent searches are stored per customer or guest session and merged on sign-in when search consumes identity.guest_session.claimed. For a customer they are saved to the account only while customers.MarketingPreferences.recentSearches is on (customers.getMarketingConsent at save time). Turning it off deletes the saved history: customers publishes customers.marketing_preferences.changed and search deletes the rows. With customers disabled, nothing is saved to accounts.
Reports read unavailable searches through zeroResultStats; query logs are not exported directly.

Optional dependencies: inventory (stock flags), reviews (ratings), sellers (store suggestions), advertising (sponsored slots), promotions (deal badges), customers (recent-search preference), orders (sales counts), audit (synonym, reindex and ranking policy changes are written to the action history when audit is enabled). With any of them off, the related fields are simply empty.

Engines (docs/02-backend-architecture.md §9): the environment variable SEARCH_ENGINE picks the MongoDB engine (mongo: stemmed words and prefixes over the read model, misspellings corrected by trigram similarity among words with the same first letter; default, development and tests) or OpenSearch (production) at startup; the API is the same with either. search_documents and search_offers stay the read model in MongoDB and feed the OpenSearch index after each commit; a full reindex builds a new versioned index and swaps the alias atomically while the live index keeps serving. GET /index reports the engine and its index (engine).
